current_repo_note: GitHub reports NOASSERTION; the repository actually splits Apache-2.0 for the bulk against a commercial licence covering packages/server/src/enterprise. Archived on 2026-08-13 with end of life announced for 2026-08-31 and no successor named.
canonical_data: flow definitions, chat history, and document stores
strengths: The bulk of the code is Apache-2.0 and the maintainers explicitly encourage forking it after the wind-down
A large adoption base and fork count leave substantial community material behind the archived repository
Both licences are stated in-repository with an explicit directory-level carve-out rather than left to detection
weaknesses: Development ceased on 2026-07-29 and the repository was archived on 2026-08-13, with published packages and images deprecated
No successor or endorsed fork is named, so a reader gets no migration target from the maintainers
The enterprise directory stays under a commercial licence conditioned on a subscription from a company winding the product down, and the fate of the hosted service is undocumented
why_it_matters: A widely adopted visual builder whose maintainers wound it down citing the shift to coding agents, making it a dated reference point for that transition.
